remarks: Fresh and clean one bedroom, one and a half bath, open floor plan loft apartment in the Clocktower! The Clocktower includes a large community room with a kitchen for parties and game night, a gym, and coin operated laundry. The two story windows and high ceilings create a sense of great space, and the storage spaces are ample. It's a great place to live and enjoy the nearby amenities of neighborhood restaurants. There is indoor parking when available at the tenant's expense. Any applicants must complete the NTN process when making an application. Come, enjoy the Clocktower! Tenant to have liability and fire insurance, and pay $250 move in fee.
